name: lean build event (executable provenance)
description: The build event: lake build as a signed term — toolchain, input sources, the build, and the output binary under one signature. The exec tier's binary golden is cross-installed from this bundle's output evidence.
copland: lseq( lseq( lseq( lseq( bseq(hashfile: tools), bseq(hashfile: inputs) ), build ), bseq(hashfile: outputs) ), SIG )
